screening_scope.purpose: Bound public phonon and full-scattering routes that might support a permitted same-regime PBTE reproduction without importing unverified rows.
screening_scope.screening_mode: metadata and public documentation review only

routes.route_boundary: The dataset is a broad phonon archive. A specific graphite record, Ding material/state equivalence, volumetric C_src(T), TTG response contract, and source-grade uncertainty were not established in this metadata-only screening.
required_follow_up: identify a specific graphite material record without treating the archive as Ding-equivalent
obtain the complete mode table, unit-cell volume, state metadata, convergence, and uncertainty
regenerate C_src(T) and the declared TTG response from the delivered payload

source_identity.title: Phonons of graphene and graphitic materials derived from the empirical potential LCBOPII

routes.route_boundary: The public paper supplies force-constant and phonon-dispersion context, but this screening did not admit a row-complete C_src(T), TTG response, uncertainty package, or Ding-equivalent material state.
required_follow_up: obtain machine-readable force constants and mode weights under permitted terms
derive modal heat capacities and volumetric C_src with a declared state and uncertainty
demonstrate the response-regime mapping before any independent-reproduction claim

source_identity.title: Code from: Full-scattering-matrix phonon BTE solver

routes.route_boundary: The public solver is useful for full-scattering numerical method context, but its declared material example is silicon and it does not supply the graphite C_src, TTG, Phi anchor, or physical UET transport records required here.
required_follow_up: keep solver constraints separate from a physical graphite source package
do not relabel a silicon solver result as graphite or UET transport evidence
obtain a state-matched physical coefficient independently

acceptance_boundary.acceptance_reason: All three routes are bounded as metadata, formula, or solver context only. None supplies a row-complete, state-matched, source-grade C_src and TTG package, an independent base-Phi/SI response, or a physical UET transport coefficient.

ontology.C: collective system-behaviour coordinate; not heat capacity or mass
ontology.Phi: effective response variable; no identity with phonon energy or temperature is asserted
ontology.R_gen: derived physical/history trace; no independent state or backreaction
ontology.R_obs: observer record separate from PBTE and transport dynamics

claim_boundary: This package closes only a scoped public-route screening lane. It does not provide numeric C_src, Ding-equivalent reproduction, alpha_Phi_K, a base-Phi SI anchor, physical UET transport, Full Topic 13 closure, or downstream dependency unlock.
